criteria.first: overhead service, upstream path on file, affected by the Feb-2025 damage set, P(outage) at 1x between 40% and 90% so the severity slider visibly moves the band, largest repair-vs-service gap among candidates on the hardest-hit circuits
criteria.life_support: declared life-support account (Observed flag), affected by the Feb-2025 set, expected restoration > 8 h at the calibrated crew count so the wellness-check escalation (rule E3) is active, P(outage) not saturated if possible
criteria.underground: underground service drop on a circuit with Feb-2025 damage, affected if possible
criteria.quiet: circuit with no Feb-2025 damage reports (territory model carries the estimate)
criteria.fallback: no upstream path on file (circuit-average fallback, Low confidence, 'being assessed')
criteria.demo: DamageSets.demo_premise(): hard-hit circuit, customer whose nearest damage is repaired >= 2 h before service returns; steps are the two scenario changes that move the midpoint the most (measured)
